items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: And then, yes that's right. Now then they, then after we got Freddie, Freddie came in from a job... ctx.x: And then, yes that's right. Now then they, then after we got Freddie, Freddie came in from a job. He played a job on his trunk. Well they wasn't, they didn't have, they didn't allow no blowing instruments.
